<?php

namespace App\Tests\Ordering\Domain;

use App\Ordering\Domain\Model\Order;
use App\Ordering\Domain\ValueObject\CustomerId;
use App\Ordering\Domain\ValueObject\OrderId;
use App\Ordering\Domain\ValueObject\ProductId;
use App\SharedKernel\Domain\Currency;
use App\SharedKernel\Domain\Money;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * Storno zaplacené objednávky zaznamená částku, kterou obchod zákazníkovi
 * vrátí ručně. Platební bránu aplikace nemá.
 */
#[CoversClass(Order::class)]
final class OrderRefundTest extends TestCase
{
    #[Test]
    public function newOrderHasNothingToRefund(): void
    {
        $order = $this->confirmedOrder(Currency::CZK);

        self::assertTrue($order->refundDue->equals(Money::zero(Currency::CZK)));
    }

    #[Test]
    public function cancelledPaidOrderRecordsPaidAmountAfterDiscount(): void
    {
        $order = $this->confirmedOrder(Currency::EUR);
        $order->markPaid();

        $order->cancel('customer request', new \DateTimeImmutable());

        // 2 × 500 € − sleva 100 €
        self::assertTrue($order->refundDue->equals(new Money(900_00, Currency::EUR)));
    }

    #[Test]
    public function cancelledUnpaidOrderHasNothingToRefund(): void
    {
        $order = $this->confirmedOrder(Currency::EUR);

        $order->cancel('customer request', new \DateTimeImmutable());

        self::assertTrue($order->refundDue->equals(Money::zero(Currency::EUR)));
    }

    #[Test]
    public function secondCancelKeepsRecordedRefund(): void
    {
        $order = $this->confirmedOrder(Currency::CZK);
        $order->markPaid();
        $order->cancel('customer request', new \DateTimeImmutable());

        $order->cancel('again', new \DateTimeImmutable());

        self::assertTrue($order->refundDue->equals(new Money(900_00, Currency::CZK)));
    }

    private function confirmedOrder(Currency $currency): Order
    {
        $order = Order::place(OrderId::generate(), CustomerId::generate(), $currency);
        $order->addItem(ProductId::generate(), 2, new Money(500_00, $currency));
        $order->applyDiscount(new Money(100_00, $currency));
        $order->confirm();

        return $order;
    }
}

    {

            return;
        }

        if (!$this->status->canTransitionTo(OrderStatus::Shipped)) {
            throw InvalidOrderStateTransitionException::cannotTransition(
                $this->status->value,
                OrderStatus::Shipped->value,
            );
        }

        $this->status = OrderStatus::Shipped;

    {

            ->subtract($this->discount);
